---
title: "Inferred Parasite Age and Dispersion by Outcome"
output: github_document
---

```{r include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

These plots show the joint distribution of the latent mean parasite age (`mu_age`) and dispersion (`sigma_age`) inferred by the hierarchical staging model under the fixed sequestration assumption, separately for patients who survived and died.

`mu_age` represents the mean of the inferred latent parasite age distribution over the 48-hour asexual cycle. `sigma_age` describes the standard deviation of that distribution.

The plots are separated by observed outcome to show whether the mean and standard deviation of the inferred latent parasite age distribution differ between survivors and deaths. Because `mu_age` is circular, values approaching 48 hours are biologically adjacent to values approaching 0 hours.

```{r load = FALSE}
library(data.table)

HIERARCHICAL_FILE <- "Staging/Imputed/outputs/CSV/dat_all_hierarchical.csv"
dat_hierarchical <- fread(HIERARCHICAL_FILE)

# Hierarchical parasite-age estimates and mortality outcome do not vary across imputations
# Use one canonical copy of each patient
dat_hierarchical <- dat_hierarchical[.imp == min(.imp)]
```

```{r add = FALSE}
# Prepare hierarchical parameter data by trial and outcome
parameter_data <- dat_hierarchical[is.finite(mu_age) & is.finite(sigma_age) &
                                   outcome %in% c(0, 1),
                                   .(ID, trial, outcome, mu_age, sigma_age)]

parameter_data[, outcome_group := ifelse(outcome == 1, "Deaths", "Survivors")]

AQMT_split_summary <- split(parameter_data[trial == "AQUAMAT"],
                            parameter_data[trial == "AQUAMAT"]$outcome_group)

SQMT_split_summary <- split(parameter_data[trial == "SEAQUAMAT"],
                            parameter_data[trial == "SEAQUAMAT"]$outcome_group)
```

```{r scatter, echo = FALSE}
# Load ggplot2 & patchwork for plots
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# State IDDO colours
AQ_col <- c("#7A3B7B", "#E31B23")
SQ_col <- c("#E37210", "#1481E7")

AQ_title <- paste0("Latent parasite-age centre and dispersion in AQUAMAT (n = ",
                   sum(parameter_data$trial == "AQUAMAT"), ")")

SQ_title <- paste0("Latent parasite-age centre and dispersion in SEAQUAMAT (n = ",
                   sum(parameter_data$trial == "SEAQUAMAT"), ")")

# Plot the relationship between mu_age and sigma_age by outcome
plot_scatter <- function(my_split_summary, my_col, my_title) {

  all_sigma <- c(my_split_summary$Deaths$sigma_age, my_split_summary$Survivors$sigma_age)
  sigma_upper <- ceiling(max(all_sigma, na.rm = TRUE) / 4) * 4

  plot_deaths <- ggplot(my_split_summary$Deaths, aes(x = mu_age, y = sigma_age)) +
    geom_point(col = my_col[1]) + theme_bw(base_size = 8) + ggtitle("Deaths") +
    xlab("Latent parasite-age centre, mu_age (h)") +
    ylab("Latent parasite-age dispersion, sigma_age (h)") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 48, 4), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, sigma_upper, 4), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 48), ylim = c(0, sigma_upper))

  plot_survivors <- ggplot(my_split_summary$Survivors, aes(x = mu_age, y = sigma_age)) +
    geom_point(col = my_col[2]) + theme_bw(base_size = 8) + ggtitle("Survivors") +
    xlab("Latent parasite-age centre, mu_age (h)") +
    ylab("Latent parasite-age dispersion, sigma_age (h)") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 48, 4), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, sigma_upper, 4), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 48), ylim = c(0, sigma_upper))

  wrap_plots(plot_deaths, plot_spacer(), plot_survivors, ncol = 3, nrow = 1) +
    plot_layout(widths = c(25, 1, 25)) + plot_annotation(title = my_title)
}

# Apply to AQUAMAT & SEAQUAMAT in turn
plot_scatter(AQMT_split_summary, AQ_col, AQ_title)
plot_scatter(SQMT_split_summary, SQ_col, SQ_title)
```
